task: I need to set up a new client project in Basecamp, including a few key to-do lists for different phases and some important documents. Then, I'll check the project's progress using a calendar view and assign some tasks to my team. Finally, I'll reorganize a to-do list and update a task's due date to reflect a change in scope.

observations.what: Sign-up was name/email/org, then password, guarded by an invisible hCaptcha on both steps; no email verification was required before landing in the app.
The Free plan allows 1 project and a blank 'My Project' is pre-created, so visiting New project redirected straight to the upgrade/plans page; I had to reuse 'My Project' as the client project.

A new project is completely blank and every tool (To-dos, Docs & Files, Calendar) must be added one by one from the plus menu; my clicks on Docs & Files and Calendar while the menu stayed open after adding To-dos did not add those tools.
Clicking the 'To-dos' title on the project card put it into rename mode (Save / Never Mind) instead of opening the tool.

The to-do form shows Assigned to, When done notify, Due on, Notes and Subtasks inline, and after saving one to-do it immediately opens a blank one so pressing Enter after typing a name added Beta and Gamma in one action each.
Typing 'Sam' in Assigned to gave an autocomplete chip in one click, and the saved to-do shows the assignee and due date as compact chips beside the name.
Picking a due date inserted a new Repeat row that pushed the 'Add this to-do' button down, so a click aimed at its old position missed.
Dragging the handle on the left of Demo Gamma moved it from third to first in a single drag with no confirmation.
Clicking the date chip on a to-do opened an inline editor with a date picker, and changing Oct 21 to Oct 28 took two clicks (date, Save).
My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.
My first click on 'Add this to-do' missed because the Repeat row had shifted the button.
I ran out of steps before creating multiple phase lists, adding documents, or opening a real calendar view.
